description: Dedicated HGRApi tool for POST api/SearchProduct/RecoverListing. This is an explicit tool with a fixed endpoint; it is not a generic endpoint caller. HGRApi functional documentation: Purpose: Recovers one hidden published product in the selected reconnected store. ownerAgent: listings. Domain: listings. Entity: recoverable_listing. Operation: recover_one. Scope: current_store. Use when: Use after the user explicitly confirms recovery of one product from getMissingListings.RecoverableListings. Input: Header channel: current ChannelOAuthId. Body ListingId is the exact HGR product ID returned in RecoverableListings, not a variation ID or marketplace PrimaryId. No import settings. Output: Returns RecoveredCount: one if recovered, zero if the product is no longer recoverable in this store. Search terms: searchproduct recoverlisting. Send the exact request payload in body. Requires confirmed=true before execution. Requires HGRApi Header channel / ChannelOAuthId resolved internally.

channelOAuthId.description: ChannelOAuthId returned by hgr_list_channels for the selected visible store.

confirmed.description: Must be true after the user explicitly requested or confirmed the exact action.

name: hgr_post_searchproduct_recoverlisting
title: Post Searchproduct Recoverlisting
